product_one_liner.value: Abacus.AI provides an AI super assistant and agentic platform that automates work for professionals and enterprises.
product_one_liner.notes: The About page describes an agentic platform built to automate white-collar work; the product documentation says the Super Assistant is for professionals, students, and teams. The one-liner summarizes its stated product and audience.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists a Pro plan at $20 per month.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 287 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The About page explicitly states the headquarters is in San Francisco. | hq_country: The company About page says Abacus.AI is headquartered in San Francisco; the associated location information identifies the United States.

founded_year.notes: The Tracxn profile for Abacus.AI states its founded year is 2019.

eng_blog.notes: The blog has at least two technical posts: one by CTO/co-founder Arvind Sundararajan describing model fine-tuning, and another coauthored by Sundararajan explaining multimodal model implementation and deployment.

public_docs.notes: The public help center links to multiple product guides and how-to articles, meeting the documentation criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers posting lists an open Research Scientist role focused on generative AI and LLMs.

model_provider.notes: The product documentation names GPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok models, supporting the corresponding publicly identified providers.
